description: Seventh release of the union lineage, after us-rulespec-2026-09-14-wave4-r2-union: the nine wave-6 program-bundle-gap ingestion runs of 2026-10-06 (federal, tax-al-hi, tax-ia-mi, tax-mn-oh, tax-ok-wv, tanf-ccdf-ak-ne, tanf-ccdf-nh-wy, health and benefits; docs/ingest-runs/2026-10-06-w6-*.md). It carries every scope of the sixth cut and the 2026-09-24 changes on main (the SNAP FY 2027 COLA memorandum, the two IRS optional sales tax table scopes, and the two table-preserving California successors that us-rulespec-2026-09-24-irs-sales-tax-tables-union selects). It adds 366 wave-6 scopes as extracted; 18 wave-5 scopes of 2026-09-15 that wave-6 decisions cite as already held; 16 signed scopes on main that no union selector carried and that wave-6 decisions cite (eleven 2026-09-23 scopes, among them the Wisconsin chapter 71 subunits re-version in place of the pit-west chapter 71 scope, and five July scopes); and 14 consolidated successors. Ten fold the shared adapter containers of the us, us-co, us-hi, us-il, us-md, us-mt, us-oh, us-or (regulation and statute) and us-wa scopes; the Oregon statute one also serves ORS 315.264 and 315.266 from the ORS chapter 315 scope in place of their recovery page rows. One is the Indiana recovery scope without IC 12-15-32-6 and 12-15-32-6.5, which the Indiana Code Title 12 scope carries. Two take M.G.L. c. 62 with the signed s. 2 scope and the California WIC bulk scope, each without the sections that a released scope already serves. One re-versions the Texas Human Resources Code scope under a lowercase version. The Indiana LIHEAP manual PY2026 edition replaces the PY2024 scope at the same path. Held out, with a decision for the owner: the whole-section 42 U.S.C. 1396a/b/d/p scope, whose text conflicts with released Medicaid scopes at 14 shared paths. See docs/ingest-runs/2026-10-07-w6-release-consolidation.md.
